en: Proverbs 9

p.src: 1  Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

en: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
u.src: 1  Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

p.src: 2  She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

en: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
u.src: 2  She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

p.src: 3  She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

en: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
u.src: 3  She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

p.src: 4  “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
u.src: 4  “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

p.src: 5  “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

en: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
u.src: 5  “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

p.src: 6  Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

en: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
u.src: 6  Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

p.src: 7  One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

en: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
u.src: 7  One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

p.src: 8  Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

en: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
u.src: 8  Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

p.src: 9  Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

en: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
u.src: 9  Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

p.src: 10  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
u.src: 10  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

p.src: 11  For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

en: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
u.src: 11  For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

p.src: 12  If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

en: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
u.src: 12  If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

p.src: 13  The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

en: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
u.src: 13  The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

p.src: 14  She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
u.src: 14  She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

p.src: 15  to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

en: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
u.src: 15  to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

p.src: 16  “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
u.src: 16  “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

p.src: 17  “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

en: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
u.src: 17  “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

p.src: 18  But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

en: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
u.src: 18  But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

en: 9:18 Sheol is the place of the dead.
